purpose: Regression fixtures for Topic Coach persistence decisions. These cases test semantic behavior, not routing. Run them with an agent/eval harness that can inspect the resulting Topic-state writes.

initial_state.nextStep: Explain how pull --rebase integrates remote and local history.

cases.learner_move: git pull --rebase就是将远端更新先拉取到本地，本地的commit跟在更新的后面吗

expected.evidence: Record supported explanation evidence for the fetch-plus-rebase mental model.
must_not: Defer the evidence solely to batch it with a future turn.
Upgrade mastery beyond what the explanation evidence supports.

initial_state.nextStep: Explain what stash preserves and when to use it.

cases.coach_move: Explain git stash while staying within the same focus.

expected.evidence: Do not create mastery evidence from acknowledgement alone.
must_not: Create a write merely because teaching occurred.

initial_state.currentFocus: Safe versus forced local branch deletion with git branch -d and -D
initial_state.nextStep: Contrast -d with -D on an unmerged branch.

accumulated_learning: The learner has already completed the branch-deletion distinction.
The learning flow has progressed through remote-tracking refs, divergence, merge/rebase, and pull --rebase.

before_advancing: Assess durable learning already observed without inventing mastery.
Run the learning-note candidate check when appropriate.
Refresh currentFocus and nextStep so persisted state no longer points to branch deletion.
Persist the logical Topic update before teaching through another materially new focus.
must_not: Continue across multiple new focused targets while leaving the persisted focus stale.

initial_state.nextStep: Understand what happens to original commits after rebase.

expected.focus_behavior: Treat this as a clarification/substep inside the existing rebase focus unless the learner demonstrates new durable evidence or continuation state materially changes.
must_not: Create evidence merely because the coach explained the answer.

initial_state.nextStep: Classify a changed commit graph by ancestry.

cases.observation: The answer is correct and independently demonstrates the targeted classification.

must: Persist the supported evidence before the turn ends.
Preserve a useful nextStep if continuation state changed.
must_not: Leave the evidence only in conversational working memory because another turn might follow.

cases.learner_move: A sustained exploration of memory retrieval introduced a relevant area absent from unassessed; learner has not answered an assessment.

must: Save useful unassessed coverage and minimal session context through one Topic update.
Keep mastery unchanged; do not create failure evidence.

cases.learner_move: Coach wrote a working agent; learner asked detailed questions but has not independently explained or modified it.

must: Capture meaningful exploration and continuation context.
Do not award level 3 or learner application evidence from generated code.

cases.learner_move: A learner-specific reusable distinction accumulated across the session and passes the note worthiness gate; no assessment occurred.

must: Create or refine the existing note owning that idea.
Link minimal session provenance when useful and preserve mastery.

cases.learner_move: A chosen Topic lesson suggests a pattern also seen in another Topic.

must: Persist only the supported chosen-Topic observation if useful.
Hand cross-Topic synthesis to Ask Coach; do not write Learning Strategy, Coach State, or another Topic.

cases.learner_move: Discussion contains a Text2SQL experiment plan and one reusable learning distinction; external project writes are not authorized.

must: Keep project details out of the Vault; give an external-project handoff without writing there.
Evaluate the reusable distinction for a Topic note without asserting mastery.

cases.learner_move: The same observation was saved; the prior write timed out but its update ID is present on reread.

must: Verify the existing result and reuse the logical update ID.
Do not duplicate evidence, note, or session.

cases.learner_move: Learner requested this interaction not be saved, then independently answered correctly.

must: Teach and give feedback without any Vault writes.
Do not let capture override the explicit non-persistence request.

cases.learner_move: A meaningful checkpoint is prepared, but the authoritative write fails and verification shows no update.

must: Report unsaved outcomes accurately.
Do not claim success or create a hidden local authority.

cases.learner_move: An available prior conversation contains a useful explanation, but its observation date is unknown.

must: Preserve useful context in a session with the actual capture timestamp and explicitly unknown observation date.
Do not fabricate observedAt, create schema-invalid evidence, or substitute the capture timestamp for the observation time.
